snippet.title: Plants vs. Zombies Delturbia 1.0 - RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Plants vs. Zombies Delturbia is a mod that overhauls PvZ 1, featuring a brand-new art style, new plants, new zombies, and entirely new worlds with unique gimmicks.
Get ready for a completely different experience than ever before… and there's still more to come!
Hope y'all enjoy it!

Music:
PvZ 2 Chinese - Parallel Universe No. 42: Final Wave
